user.title: Netztest AT
user.description: Measures with the official RTR client against RTR's servers (Austria). Every test is submitted to RTR and published anonymised as open data (truncated IP, provider, no location). If another speed-test program is running, the test waits until it has finished. Privacy policy and terms of use: {terms_url}

data.plan_download: Contract download in Mbit/s (optional, for % plan compliance)
data.accept_rtr_terms: I agree to the RTR-NetTest privacy policy and terms of use
data.random_delay: Random delay up to (minutes, 0 = exactly on time)

abort.binary_unavailable: The RTR measurement client could not be provided: {error}

error.invalid_times: Times as HH:MM, comma-separated; 1–24 tests per day, at least 30 minutes apart.
error.terms_required: The test cannot be used without agreeing to the RTR terms.
